correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed independent root Bernoulli indicators B_j with P(B_j=1)=1/(j-1) and independent alternative parents U_j uniform in {2,...,j-1}. Conditional on R=k+1, root-attachment subset A has fixed-cardinality weights product_{j in A}1/(j-2)/e_k. The weighted-subset inclusion lemma follows by induction using Newton log-concavity of the elementary symmetric functions and monotonic Bernoulli coupling for the final indicator, then chaining adjacent couplings. Shared U_j yields C_v[k+1]=sum_{j>v}1{j not in A_k}1{U_j=v}, so each coordinate decreases and leaf indicators increase. On independent event U_j=j-1 for every j>=3, probability 1/(n-2)!, each new root attachment deletes the previous parent’s only child, making the leaf count strictly larger at every adjacent k. Independently enumerated exact parent sequences for n=3..8 and checked all strict leaf means and all upward principal leaf-set events by root degree.

value.rationale: PASS: This gives a simultaneous multivariate stochastic order under every exact root degree, controlling all increasing functionals of the nonroot offspring vector and all monotone leaf-set events, not merely one covariance or mean. Conditional degree ordering is a natural recursive-tree structural invariant, and exact-level joint control is useful for conditional occupancy and leaf events.

limitations: The theorem concerns only nonroot offspring vector, not stochastic order of full rooted-tree shapes.
Best-of-knowledge originality is especially qualified by standard stochastic covering combined with prior recursive-parent representation.
